title: inventory/topology-observed.json
description: Observed physical topology (Kind snapshot). Health Device, topology mode only. One file, rewritten each map; changes[] is the ring of what moved between maps. devices[] is what a digital twin needs (name, platform, node_definition, software_version, interfaces); links[] is who is cabled to whom as CDP/LLDP saw it; unresolved[] is a neighbor the inventory does not know. Everything here is observed. Intended topology lives elsewhere (git). No config, no counters, no health.

keys.description: Union of device keys and every interface key on links[].

status.description: ok: every ranked device probed and every link seen from both ends or from a device whose far end has no RESTCONF. gaps: a probe failed, or a link between two RESTCONF devices was seen from one end only. unavailable: nothing probed.

headline.description: Devices mapped, links found, unresolved count, and what changed since prior_mapped_at (or 'first map').

scope.description: "all" or the device keys the task line named. A scoped map replaces only links seen from those devices.

neighbor_protocol_absent.description: Devices where both the CDP and LLDP GET returned 204/404/empty.

devices.description: Every inventory/prod.json device that was probed, plus every inventory device that appeared as a neighbor (collected false).

links.description: One row per physical link, unordered. Loopback, Vlan, and management ports are not links.

unresolved.description: A CDP/LLDP neighbor whose name does not match any inventory/prod.json device. No key is minted for it.

changes.description: Ring of the last 10 change events across maps, oldest first. Empty on the first map.

node_definition.description: prod.json source_metadata.node_definition. Never from the device.

software_version.description: From the live platform call. Null when not collected.

collected.description: true when this map probed the device. false when it is here only because a probed device named it as a neighbor.

cidr.description: Primary IPv4 as address/prefix when the interface has one. Lets the health visit resolve a BGP neighbor id to a device without any other system.

interfaces.description: Every interface the device returned, including admin-down and Loopback (a twin needs the slots; BGP peers often sit on loopbacks). Empty when collected is false.

keys.description: Both interface keys and both device keys.

a.description: Lower device name sorts first, so the same link always has the same a/b.

seen_from.description: Which end(s) reported it. One entry when the far end has no RESTCONF, was out of scope, or did not report the link.

neighbor_name.description: device-name / device-id as returned, domain suffix removed.

platform_hint.description: CDP platform string when present. Helps a human add the device to inventory.

subject.description: The interface key (links, link_moved: the local end), or device key.

prior.description: Prior far end, version, or null.

current.description: Current far end, version, or null.
